experiment.name: SPEAR_c384_pres_SST_HIST_AllForc_IC1979_K50_ens_01_2018
experiment.description:
6/21/2018 AMIP version of SPEAR_c192_o1_Control_1850_K50.
3/29/2019 Extend from 10 years to 42. First 10 years are stored as SPEAR_c192_pres_SST_HIST_AllForc_IC1979_G50_ens_01
4/10/2019 Extend data to end of 2018.
VOLCANOES. Previous runs used 1850 fixed Volcano and Solar forcings. (Volcano_Solar_1850_cmip6) Change to timeseries Volcano_Solar_TimeSeries_cmip6_v3 (Data out to 2100). CHANGES ANSWERS.
OZONE CLIMATOLOGY. common_cmip6 has 1849-2014 data (repeats 2014 data into 2015) common_cmip6_ssp585 has 2000-2101 data. Data for 2000-2014 is identical. Take 1/1849-12/2000 data from common_cmip6 and merge with common_cmip6_ssp585 (2000-2101) data to create longer timeseries. NO CHANGE IN ANSWERS
GHG_ODS_conc common_cmip6 has data to 2016 but repeats values from 2014 for 2015,2016. Use common_cmip_ssp585 GHG file instead. Data goes to 2500. NO CHANGE IN ANSWERS
EMISSIONS emissions_cmip6_v20161213 have data from 1/1849 to 12/2016. Should have used emissions_cmip6_v20170518 Use a combination of emissions_cmip6_v20170518 and emissions_cmip6_ssp585 See $(SD_ARCHIVE_ROOT)/SPEAR/datasets/1849_2101/README for how the file was created. CHANGES ANSWERS.
SST Extend hadisst sst and ice data to 12/2018. Follow the procedure at https://cobweb.gfdl.noaa.gov/~cjg/awg/utils/hadisst2fms.html Data prior to 12/2012 should be reproduced. NO CHANGE IN ANSWERS.
5/31/2019 Experienced a sat_vapor_pres error in 1995/8/9-19 timeframe. Flip make_exchange_reproduce to .false. and extend run.

The number of diagnostic vertical coordinates to use. ! For each coordinate, an entry in DIAG_COORDS must be provided. DIAG_COORDS = "z Z ZSTAR", "rho2 RHO2 RHO" !
DIAG_COORD_DEF_RHO2 = "RFNC1:35,999.5,1028,1028.5,8.,1038.,0.0078125" ! default = "WOA09" ! Determines how to specify the coordinate ! resolution. Valid options are: ! PARAM - use the vector-parameter DIAG_COORD_RES_RHO2 ! UNIFORM[:N] - uniformly distributed ! FILE:string - read from a file. The string specifies ! the filename and variable name, separated ! by a comma or space, e.g. FILE:lev.nc,dz ! or FILE:lev.nc,interfaces=zw ! WOA09[:N] - the WOA09 vertical grid (approximately) ! FNC1:string - FNC1:dz_min,H_total,power,precision ! HYBRID:string - read from a file. cat > $work/INPUT/SIS_layout << SIS_LAYOUT_EOF #override IO_LAYOUT = $ice_io_layout #override LAYOUT = $ice_layout #override MASKTABLE = $ocn_mask_table SIS_LAYOUT_EOF
